name: Open WebUI
summary: A chat page for the local models, for the people on your network. Everyone signs in with an account: the administrator's account is created at the first start from the e-mail address and the password set here, and the administrator then adds the others.
license: Open WebUI License (BSD-3-Clause terms plus a branding clause)

admin_email.label: Administrator's e-mail address, the sign-in name (used once, when the first account is created)

secrets.label: Administrator's password (used once, when the first account is created)
